title: Head of AI
summary: A Head of AI sets a company's AI strategy and turns it into products that work. They pick which use cases to fund, lead the AI engineering and data science teams, decide what to build or buy, set AI governance with risk and legal teams, and answer to the CEO or CTO for the value, cost and risk of AI.
dailyDuties: Set the AI strategy and roadmap with business leaders
Choose and fund AI use cases and stop weak ones
Lead AI engineering, data science and MLOps teams
Decide build or buy for models, platforms and vendors
Set AI governance and review high-risk use cases
Report AI value, spend and risk to the CEO and board

skills.expectation: Set the AI strategy and choose which use cases to fund
Lead AI architecture and build or buy choices
Know how GenAI products are built and where they fail
Make sure models run reliably and are monitored in production
Set AI governance, risk and policy with legal and risk teams
Build and lead AI engineering and data science teams
Hire senior AI engineers and leaders
Report AI value, cost and risk to the CEO and board
Work with business heads on adoption and value
Review designs for large ML and GenAI systems
Set how GenAI quality is measured
Control GPU and model API spend
Plan and track the AI budget
Manage model, cloud and AI vendor contracts
